components.css: .ds-stage { background: var(--bg, #121316); color: var(--text, #eef0f2); font-family: var(--sans, "Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.45; padding: 20px; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; } .ds-frame { position: relative; width: 300px; aspect-ratio: 390 / 844; border-radius: 22px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--slate, #1b1d22); box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -20px #000c, 0 0 0 1px #ffffff14; } .ds-scrim { position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0 0; padding: 150px 20px 20px; background: linear-gradient(to top, #0a0a0b 0%, #0a0a0b 55%, #0a0a0bcc 75%, transparent); } .ds-scrim h3 { font: 500 48px/.92 var(--display, Antonio, "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .005em; margin: 0 0 8px; text-wrap: balance; color: var(--text, #eef0f2); } .ds-facts { color: #d7dbe0; font-size: 13px; display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-why { margin-top: 10px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; background: #ffffff1a; backdrop-filter: blur(6px); } .ds-why-over { color: var(--coral, #ff6b5e); } .ds-why svg { flex: none; }

narrative.overview:
The console is dark because of how it is used: one operator, beside WhatsApp Desktop, working through leads whose best asset is their own mockup site. The shell is a stack of near-black slates that recede, so on Today the brightest, most colourful thing on screen is the shop's scroll video, standing full height in a phone frame, with its actions stacked on a rail beside it. Every other screen is a dense, ordinary console: a side nav with counts, a board, a table with a drawer, a metrics page. They share the same small set of controls and chips.

Colour carries meaning, never decoration. White is the go voice and the active state. Sand is the one warm neutral, used for the wordmark, production stages and secondary data. Green, amber and coral each mean exactly one thing, and every state is coded twice, by chip shape and by colour. Type is a two-face system: Antonio, a tall condensed face in capitals, for shop names, screen titles and big figures, and Schibsted Grotesk for everything else, with tracked capitals on buttons and labels. The first screen rejects the CRM default of KPI tiles over a kanban of text cards.

Depth comes from tone, not shadow; only the phone frame and the toast lift. Motion is short and quiet: 120 to 150ms colour fades on hover, and one expo-out curve for the slide that leaves after an action, the drawer, the bottom sheet and the toast, all switched off under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Dark by use: void-to-mist slate shell, colour reserved for the lead's own media and for signals.
One lead at a time on Today: full-height phone frame, near-solid caption scrim, action rail, message column.
White is primary and active; green only on WhatsApp send; amber due; coral overdue or declined.
State is double-coded: outline circle, filled circle, rotated square, strikethrough.
Condensed capitals for names and titles, a clean grotesk for the rest, tracked capitals on controls.
Outlined controls, lucide line icons at a 1.5 stroke, 1px borders, tonal surfaces, almost no shadow.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: WhatsApp green appears only on WhatsApp send actions. It never marks success, done, online or a chart series.

rules.name: The White Is Go Rule
rules.body: White is the primary and active colour. No coloured brand accent competes with it.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber means due; coral means overdue or declined. Neither is used as decoration, emphasis or a chart colour.

rules.name: The Bare Number Rule
rules.body: Tabular figures apply only to bare numbers: nav counts, segment counts, column counts, bar values, the feed position. Ratings, review counts with commas and dates stay proportional, because Schibsted Grotesk widens punctuation under tnum.

rules.name: The Condensed Name Rule
rules.body: Antonio is for shop names, screen titles, column heads and big figures, always in capitals. Buttons, labels and body copy are Schibsted Grotesk.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: No kickers or eyebrow labels above headings. The 11px tracked label is itself the heading of a side or panel section; it never sits stacked above a display title.

rules.name: The Phone Feed Rule
rules.body: On phone, Today is a full-bleed feed: the frame loses its radius and shadow and fills the screen, the rail floats over the video at the right, the message moves into a bottom sheet opened from the rail, and a 64px tab bar replaces the side nav.

rules.name: The Flat Console Rule
rules.body: Cards, panels, columns, inputs and the nav cast no shadow. Only the phone frame and the toast lift.

rules.name: The Scrim Rule
rules.body: The Today caption sits on a near-solid scrim that ends just above the shop name: void, solid to 55%, 80% at 75%, then clear. Name, facts and the why chip always read on solid void, whatever the video shows.

rules.name: The Shape Carries State Rule
rules.body: State shows through chip shape as well as colour: an outline circle for open, a filled circle for done, a rotated square for overdue, strikethrough for closed. Colour reinforces the shape; it never stands alone.

rules.name: The Line Icon Rule
rules.body: Icons are lucide line icons at a 1.5 stroke: 18px by default, 22px on the rail, 13px beside a rating. No unicode glyphs as icons.

dos: Do use white (#ffffff) with void ink for primary actions and the active state; everything else is outlined in mist (1px) with 12px tracked capitals.
Do reserve WhatsApp green (#25d366, ink #04210f) for the WhatsApp send action.
Do mark amber (#f2b24a) for due and coral (#ff6b5e) for overdue or declined, and nothing else.
Do code every state by shape and colour: outline circle open, filled circle done, rotated square overdue, strikethrough closed.
Do apply tabular figures only to bare numbers.
Do draw icons with lucide at a 1.5 stroke (18px default, 22px on the rail).
Do step surfaces by tone (bg #121316, panel #16171b, slate #1b1d22, raised #22252c) and separate them with 1px borders.
Do keep the Today caption on the near-solid void scrim that ends just above the shop name.
Do switch Today to the full-bleed feed, bottom-sheet message and 64px tab bar at 760px and below.
Do keep transitions between 120 and 250ms, move things (slide, drawer, sheet, toast) on cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1), and turn transitions off under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use green for success, online status, confirmation or charts.
Don't use amber or coral as decoration, emphasis or a data colour.
Don't tell states apart by colour alone.
Don't put kickers or eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't use unicode glyphs as icons.
Don't set tabular figures on ratings, comma-grouped counts or dates.
Don't add shadows to cards, panels, columns or inputs.
Don't set buttons, labels or body copy in Antonio.
